critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile there are no reported automated violations, no touch-target violations, no horizontal document overflow, and reduced-motion testing shows no hero animation. The keyboard path reaches #unknowns, and the skip-link target has measurable dimensions. However, accessibility is not demo-ready because every viewport has unresolved serious aria-prohibited-attr findings (6 nodes), critical duplicate-id-aria findings (2 nodes), and hundreds of unresolved color-contrast checks (553 desktop, 508 tablet, 484 mobile). Evidence also covers only the navigation path, not complete keyboard operation and visible focus for controls within this screen.
critique.fix: Correct prohibited ARIA attributes and make all IDs referenced by ARIA or labels unique. Measure and remediate contrast for every flagged text and UI element. Then provide a clean audit plus screen-level keyboard evidence covering focus order, visible focus, activation of “Return to thesis,” skip-link behavior, and operation without a pointer at all three viewports.
